description: Set DNS records and/or nameservers of a domain you own. records: [{type: A|AAAA|CNAME|MX|TXT|NS (SRV/CAA/ALIAS not supported on hosted DNS: use custom nameservers), name: '@'|sub, value, ttl?, priority? (MX)}]. mode 'replace' (default) replaces the FULL record set; mode 'merge' adds/updates the given records, deletes any in remove [{type,name,value?}], and keeps everything else (safer for adding MX/TXT next to a website).
name: set_dns
title: Set DNS records / nameservers
